title: ticfac sandbox worker-prompt accepts schema-invalid and path-escaping tick records that tk refused
description:
readSandboxTick (internal/cli/sandbox.go:697-711) only JSON-decodes the record. A tick {"id":"a1w","title":"t"} renders a prompt where tk exited 1 because status is required. `--tick ../evil` reads .tick/evil.json and renders branch tick//evil. The code's own comment says booting a worker on damaged state is worse than not booting. Validate the id as a tick id, and the record's required fields, as tk did.

ticfac run epic-6in filed this backlog tick from the finding 83fcb9a55a986df383767279dafb875d4170e0a23072e4f1fc31b15a0882208c (reported by run-epic-6in/tick-tdu/attempt-7): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-6in/absorptions/83fcb9a55a986df383767279dafb875d4170e0a23072e4f1fc31b15a0882208c.json on the run branch.
